name: What factors have the biggest impact on interior renovation costs?

mainEntity.name: What factors have the biggest impact on interior renovation costs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior renovation costs vary widely based on square footage, existing conditions, and finish material selections. Basic cosmetic updates—such as drywall patching, trim carpentry, and interior painting—fall on the lower end of the pricing spectrum. Extensive renovations that involve structural wall removal, custom tile or marble installation, and full plumbing or electrical reconfigurations increase both labor and material costs. Choosing high-end custom cabinetry versus semi-custom lines, or natural stone over ceramic tile, creates substantial price differences. An on-site consultation is essential to evaluate structural framing, subfloor integrity, and specific trade requirements for an accurate estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior renovation costs are primarily driven by project square footage, finish material choices like stone or custom trim, and structural, electrical, or plumbing modifications.
